title_en: US plans to deport Afghans back to their home country through Pakistan, documents show
title_zh: 文件显示，美国计划通过巴基斯坦将阿富汗人驱逐回祖国
summary: The Trump administration plans to deport Afghans detained in the U.S. back to Afghanistan via Pakistan
summary_zh: 特朗普政府计划将在美国被拘留的阿富汗人经巴基斯坦驱逐回阿富汗
body_en: US plans to deport Afghans back to their home country through Pakistan, documents show
The Trump administration plans to deport Afghans detained in the U.S. back to Afghanistan via Pakistan

President Donald Trump's administration is planning to deport Afghans detained in the U.S. back to their home country via Pakistan, according to court documents obtained by The Associated Press — a move advocacy groups say could put their lives at risk.

Immigrant rights organizations say those deported could face retaliation from the Taliban . Thousands fled persecution and feared for their lives after helping the U.S. military and aid groups in Afghanistan.

“This is absolutely unconscionable," said Shawn VanDiver, a U.S. Navy veteran and president of the advocacy group #AfghanEvac. “It seems like there’s no end to their willingness to break the law and violate people’s human rights.”

The U.S. intends to initially deport Afghan immigrants as early as Monday on flights from Louisiana, where the Immigration and Customs Enforcement agency has immigrant detention and processing facilities, to Pakistan, according to court documents.

The plan to deport Afghans to Pakistan was first reported by Bloomberg on Monday. On Friday, The New York Times reported that the immigrants were going to be sent to Afghanistan after arriving in Pakistan.

A spokesperson for the U.S. Department of Homeland Security said in an email to the AP on Saturday that ICE does not comment on future immigrant-removal operations, citing operational security and personnel safety. Officials at the Pakistani Embassy in Washington did not immediately return email messages.
U.S. officials confirmed the Afghan deportations in sealed court documents obtained by the AP.

In a document filed in federal court in Virginia on Friday, a senior ICE official acknowledged that an Afghan immigrant had been scheduled to be on an upcoming charter flight from Alexandria, Louisiana, to Pakistan, “with further transport onward to Afghanistan.” The document was filed in the case of an immigrant who is not in custody and is challenging efforts to deport him.
In another federal court case in Oklahoma, federal prosecutors filed a document on Monday disclosing that another Afghan immigrant was scheduled to be deported to Afghanistan sometime next week.

The Trump administration has deported thousands of immigrants to countries other than their own. It has done this in some instances when it is unable to send them to their own countries because the US does not have formal relations, like with the Taliban government in Afghanistan. In other instances, it has been used as a deterrent.

In many cases, a U.S. immigration judge has determined their lives would be in jeopardy if sent to their home countries. It was not immediately clear if any designated for return to Afghanistan have protective orders against being sent there.

2 college students found dead after going missing while hiking, police say

Human Rights First, an advocacy group for refugees and asylum seekers that tracks U.S. deportation flights, said Saturday that it had confirmed a scheduled flight from Louisiana to Pakistan on Tuesday carrying Afghan immigrants.

“It is beyond egregious that this administration plans to carry out an unprecedented mass deportation flight of Afghans, forcibly sending them through Pakistan and into the hands of the Taliban,” Savitri Arvey, director of policy, refugee and immigrant rights for Human Rights First, said in an email to the AP.

“This follows previous unconscionable deportation flights we have tracked under this administration, including Iranian Christian converts and political dissidents removed via Qatar and Kuwait to Iran, as well as a Russian political dissident removed via Egypt to Russia,” Arvey said.
Some Democratic members of Congress took to social media to criticize the Afghan deportations after seeing the Times story on Friday.
body_zh: 文件显示，美国计划通过巴基斯坦将阿富汗人驱逐回祖国
特朗普政府计划将在美国被拘留的阿富汗人经巴基斯坦驱逐回阿富汗
美联社获得的法庭文件显示，唐纳德·特朗普总统的政府正计划将在美国被拘留的阿富汗人经巴基斯坦驱逐回祖国，倡导团体称此举可能会危及他们的生命。
移民权利组织表示，那些被驱逐出境的人可能会面临塔利班的报复。数千人在向阿富汗的美国军队和援助组织提供帮助后逃离迫害，并担心自己的生命安全。
“这绝对是不合理的，”美国海军退伍军人、倡导组织 #AfghanEvac 的主席肖恩·范迪弗 (Shawn VanDiver) 说。 “他们违法和侵犯人民人权的意愿似乎永无止境。”
法庭文件显示，美国打算最早于周一搭乘从路易斯安那州飞往巴基斯坦的航班开始驱逐阿富汗移民。路易斯安那州的移民和海关执法机构在路易斯安那州设有移民拘留和处理设施。
彭博社周一首次报道了将阿富汗人驱逐到巴基斯坦的计划。周五，《纽约时报》报道称，这些移民抵达巴基斯坦后将被送往阿富汗。
美国国土安全部发言人周六在给美联社的一封电子邮件中表示，ICE 不会对未来的移民驱逐行动发表评论，理由是行动安全和人员安全。巴基斯坦驻华盛顿大使馆的官员没有立即回复电子邮件。
美国官员在美联社获得的密封法庭文件中证实了阿富汗人被驱逐出境的情况。
在周五向弗吉尼亚州联邦法院提交的一份文件中，ICE 的一名高级官员承认，一名阿富汗移民原定乘坐即将搭乘的包机从路易斯安那州亚历山大飞往巴基斯坦，“并进一步运送到阿富汗”。该文件是针对一名未被拘留的移民提交的，他正在对驱逐他的努力提出质疑。
在俄克拉荷马州的另一起联邦法院案件中，联邦检察官周一提交了一份文件，披露另一名阿富汗移民计划于下周某个时候被驱逐到阿富汗。
特朗普政府已将数千名移民驱逐到本国以外的国家。在某些情况下，当由于美国没有正式关系（例如与阿富汗塔利班政府）而无法将他们派遣到自己的国家时，它会这样做。在其他情况下，它被用作威慑。
在许多情况下，美国移民法官判定，如果他们被遣返回国，他们的生命将面临危险。目前尚不清楚指定返回阿富汗的人是否有保护令不被送往那里。

追踪美国驱逐航班的难民和寻求庇护者倡导组织“人权第一”周六表示，已确认周二有一架从路易斯安那州飞往巴基斯坦的定期航班载有阿富汗移民。
人权第一组织政策、难民和移民权利主任萨维特里·阿尔维在给美联社的电子邮件中表示：“本届政府计划对阿富汗人进行前所未有的大规模驱逐飞行，强行将他们送往巴基斯坦并落入塔利班手中，这实在令人震惊。”
阿维说：“在此之前，我们曾追踪过本届政府领导下的不合理驱逐航班，其中包括通过卡塔尔和科威特被驱逐到伊朗的伊朗基督教皈依者和政治异见人士，以及通过埃及被驱逐到俄罗斯的俄罗斯政治异见人士。”
周五，一些民主党国会议员在看到《泰晤士报》的报道后，在社交媒体上批评了驱逐阿富汗人的做法。

title_en: Golden State wins first WNBA title in franchise history
title_zh: 金州勇士队赢得球队历史上第一个 WNBA 冠军
summary: The title was won in the first Game 7 in WNBA Finals history.
summary_zh: WNBA总决赛历史上首次在第七场比赛中夺冠。
body_en: The Golden State Valkyries brought to a conclusion a WNBA season that shattered viewership and attendance records with their first WNBA championship Saturday in a thrilling 68-63 victory over the Atlanta Dream in Game 7.
Golden State star Gabby Williams paced the Valkyries with 30 points, 4 blocks and 3 steals in 38 minutes.
"All we heard last year: We don't have no stars, we don't have no talent," Williams said after the game. "Yeah right. We got good people. We got winners."

Jordin Canada led the Atlanta Dream in scoring with 18 points, adding 5 assists and 4 rebounds. Atlanta superstar Angel Reese struggled throughout the game, finishing with 8 points on 3-of-7 shooting in 33 minutes.
The victory was the first for a team in a Game 7. The league transitioned from a five-game series to a seven-game series starting last year.
This is the first title for the Valkyries in just their second season as a team. And the Dream are now winless in four WNBA Finals appearances.

The 2026 season was an unqualified success for the WNBA. The league set a new attendance record with 3.8 million fans attending 330 regular season games, according to the WNBA . The league said average attendance was up 21% from last year's record high.

ESPN, ABC and CBS all delivered their most-watched seasons in history, according to the WNBA. The league had three times as many games averaging at least 1 million viewers as the previous record set last year.
The Valkyries, despite having just one All-Star, took a major leap in just their second year in the league.

The team is owned by Joe Lacob and Peter Guber, who also own the Golden State Warriors. The team quickly became relevant, going 23-21 in their first year in existence before losing in the first round of the playoffs.

The signing of Gabby Williams in the offseason propelled the team to even greater success. The Valkyries went 32-12 in the regular season and beat the Paige Bueckers-led Dallas Wings and A'ja Wilson-led Las Vegas Aces to advance to the title series.
The Dream didn't lose a game on its path to the title series, defeating the Kiki Iriafen-led Washington Mystics and the Breanna Stewart-led New York Liberty in sweeps.

The Valkyries won Game 1 at home, 68-64, behind 26 points from Williams. Atlanta dominated the next two games behind all-time great performances from star Angel Reese. The Dream star posted 30 points and 16 rebounds in Game 2 and 21 points and 12 rebounds in Game 3.
Reese struggled to score in Games 4 and 5, shooting just 4-of-20 with 15 points combined, as the Valkyries wrestled control of the series away from the Dream.

Game 6 started at 12:30 p.m. since the Atlanta Hawks were scheduled to play at the State Farm Arena on Thursday night. The Dream plays its regular season games at Gateway Center Arena, but its capacity is just 3,500 compared to about 17,000 at State Farm Arena.

"This incredible run by our players has also made something else abundantly clear: the Atlanta Dream has earned the right to be taken seriously," the team's ownership, husband and wife Larry Gottesdiener and Robyn Gottesdiener, Suzanne Abair and Renee Montgomery, said in a statement.

"Two months ago, when the WNBA finalized playoff dates and times, we raised concerns that the W Finals schedule conflicted with NBA games at State Farm Arena," the statement continued. "As we moved through the playoffs, we reiterated those concerns. Our concerns did not receive the attention, nor the urgency that they deserved."
Despite the early start time, the Dream still sold out the arena.
In a statement, WNBA Commissioner Cathy Engelbert said the league preferred to play the game at State Farm Arena.

"The sellout crowds and extraordinary atmosphere at State Farm Arena for Games 3 and 4 were a tremendous success, and we're excited to give thousands more fans the opportunity to experience Game 6 with a championship on the line," said Engelbert. "We thank the NBA, Dream, Valkyries, Hawks, State Farm Arena and USA Network for the collaboration and flexibility that made this move possible. We look forward to delivering another unforgettable Finals experience in Atlanta."
body_zh: 周六，金州女武神队在第七场比赛中以 68-63 惊心动魄地战胜亚特兰大梦想队，打破了收视率和上座率纪录，夺得了他们的首个 WNBA 冠军，为 WNBA 赛季画上了圆满的句号。
金州勇士队球星加比·威廉姆斯在 38 分钟内拿下 30 分、4 次盖帽和 3 次抢断，为女武神队奠定了基础。
“去年我们听到的都是：我们没有球星，我们没有天赋，”威廉姆斯赛后说道。 “是的，没错。我们有好人。我们有赢家。”
乔丹·加拿大队拿下18分、5次助攻和4个篮板，成为亚特兰大梦想队得分王。亚特兰大巨星安吉尔·里斯整场比赛表现不佳，上场33分钟7投3中得到8分。
这是球队在第七场比赛中取得的第一场胜利。从去年开始，联盟从五场系列赛转变为七场系列赛。
这是瓦尔基里队在入队第二个赛季以来的第一个冠军。而梦想队现在已经四次闯入 WNBA 总决赛，未尝一胜。
2026 赛季对于 WNBA 来说是绝对的成功。根据 WNBA 的数据，该联盟创下了新的观众人数纪录，有 380 万名球迷观看了 330 场常规赛比赛。联盟表示，平均上座率比去年的历史新高增加了 21%。
据 WNBA 称，ESPN、ABC 和 CBS 都创下了历史上收视率最高的赛季。该联盟场均至少 100 万观众的比赛数量是去年创下的纪录的三倍。
瓦尔基里队尽管只有一名全明星球员，但在进入联盟的第二年就取得了重大飞跃。
该球队的所有者是乔·拉科布和彼得·古伯，他们也拥有金州勇士队。球队很快就变得举足轻重，在成立的第一年就取得了 23 胜 21 负的战绩，但在季后赛第一轮就失利了。
休赛期签下加比·威廉姆斯推动球队取得更大的成功。瓦尔基里队在常规赛中取得了 32 胜 12 负的战绩，击败了佩奇·布克斯 (Paige Bueckers) 领导的达拉斯翼队 (Dallas Wings) 和阿贾·威尔逊 (A'ja Wilson) 领导的拉斯维加斯王牌队 (Las Vegas Aces)，晋级冠军系列赛。
梦想队在通往冠军系列赛的道路上没有输掉一场比赛，横扫了奇奇·伊里亚芬（Kiki Iriafen）领导的华盛顿神秘队​​（Washington Mystics）和布雷安娜·斯图尔特（Breanna Stewart）领导的纽约自由队（New York Liberty）。
女武神队在主场以68-64赢得第一场比赛，落后威廉姆斯26分。凭借球星安吉尔·里斯 (Angel Reese) 的出色表现，亚特兰大在接下来的两场比赛中占据了主导地位。这位梦想球星在第二场比赛中得到30分和16个篮板，在第三场比赛中得到21分和12个篮板。
里斯在第四场和第五场比赛中得分不佳，20投仅4中，总共得到15分，而女武神队则从梦想队手中夺走了系列赛的控制权。
第六场比赛于中午12点30分开始。因为亚特兰大老鹰队原定于周四晚上在州立农场竞技场进行比赛。梦想队在盖特威中心球馆 (Gateway Center Arena) 举行常规赛季比赛，但其容量仅为 3,500 人，而州立农场球馆 (State Farm Arena) 的容量约为 17,000 人。
“我们球员令人难以置信的表现也清楚地表明了其他一些事情：亚特兰大梦已经赢得了被认真对待的权利，”球队老板拉里·戈特斯迪纳（Larry Gottesdiener）和罗宾·戈特斯迪纳（Robyn Gottesdiener）夫妇、苏珊娜·阿贝尔（Suzanne Abair）和蕾妮·蒙哥马利（Renee Montgomery）在一份声明中表示。
声明继续说道：“两个月前，当 WNBA 敲定季后赛日期和时间时，我们担心 WNBA 总决赛赛程与 State Farm Arena 的 NBA 比赛发生冲突。” “当我们进入季后赛时，我们重申了这些担忧。我们的担忧没有得到应有的关注，也没有得到应有的紧迫性。”
尽管开赛时间较早，但梦想球馆的门票仍然售罄。
WNBA 专员凯茜·恩格尔伯特在一份声明中表示，联盟更愿意在 State Farm Arena 进行比赛。
恩格尔伯特说：“第三场和第四场比赛在 State Farm Arena 的观众席爆满，氛围非凡，取得了巨大成功，我们很高兴能让更多球迷有机会体验第六场比赛，争夺冠军。” “我们感谢 NBA、梦想队、瓦尔基里队、老鹰队、State Farm Arena 和 USA Network 的合作和灵活性，使这一举措成为可能。我们期待在亚特兰大带来另一场难忘的总决赛体验。”

title_en: Golden State Valkyries defeat Atlanta Dream for franchise’s first WNBA title
title_zh: 金州女武神队击败亚特兰大梦想队，夺得球队首个 WNBA 冠军
summary: In only their second season in existence, the Golden State Valkyries are WNBA champions.
summary_zh: 金州武神队仅在他们存在的第二个赛季就获得了 WNBA 冠军。
body_en: Oct. 31, 2026, 10:25 PM EDT / Updated Oct. 31, 2026, 11:05 PM EDT
In only their second season in existence, the Golden State Valkyries are WNBA champions.
The Valkyries won their first title in franchise history on Saturday, defeating the Atlanta Dream 68-63 in the first Game 7 in WNBA Finals history. Forward Gabby Williams led with 30 points.
Confetti rained down onto the court as the crowd erupted in cheers, and the Valkyries celebrated the historic victory.

“I love moments like this,” Williams said after the final buzzer. “Nat told me to be patient in the first half. It was hard, but I listened to her. She’s right as always and she got us here,” she said referring to head coach Natalie Nakase.

Williams was named the Finals MVP following her stunning performance, scoring more points than anybody in a half in WNBA post-season history. Though she scored just two points in the first half, she rallied with 15 points in the third quarter and 13 in the fourth.
Accepting her award, she said, “I wasn’t gonna lose on Halloween.”

“This is just incredible,” she said on her fourth championship title. “But just my teammates, they’re amazing. The love that we feel is just incredible. I mean, this one just might be as good as my first.”

Guard Veronica Burton, who played a key role in the Valkyries’ offense, was asked what she would tell her younger self, who just a few years ago was at home working out out at a YMCA, waiting for the opportunity to play in the WNBA.

“I would tell her it’s all worth it. Like, it’s not over. Don’t let anyone put a limit on you,” she said. “We didn’t let anyone put a limit on us all year. And when you work, and when you put your head down and you grind, like, anything is possible.”
Golden State’s quick rise to the top of the sport, coupled with the team’s rabid fanbase, has already made the Valkyries one of the signature franchises in the WNBA.

In the team’s inaugural season, Golden State finished 23-21 and bowed out in the first round of the playoffs, the only time an expansion team reached the postseason in its first year in league history.
Prior to the 2026 season, the Valkyries rebuilt their frontcourt, signing Williams after she made her first All-Star team, and also adding Stokes, previously of the Las Vegas Aces, via free agency.

Williams became the team’s leading scorer, while Stokes added a rebounding presence in the middle. Directing the action was fifth-year guard Burton, who led the team in assists during the regular season.

The rebuilt roster allowed Nakase — a two-time champion as a player and the reigning Coach of the Year — to push the right buttons in the Finals. After Golden State won the first game, Atlanta roared back with double-digit blowout wins to take a 2-1 lead.

Nakase shortened her rotation after Game 3, while also swapping out multiple players in her starting lineup. As she leaned more heavily on on her big three of Williams, Stokes and Burton, the Valkyries answered with two consecutive wins of its own to retake the series edge, at 3-2.

Atlanta staved off elimination Thursday in Game 6 in Atlanta in a game that tipped off at 12:30 p.m. ET due to difficulties scheduling around previous events taking place at Atlanta’s State Farm Arena, a much larger venue than the Dream’s typical home arena, which seats fewer than 4,000.
Golden State’s championship run coincided with a business boom for the franchise, which has the same principal ownership group as the NBA’s Golden State Warriors.

In May, CNBC valued Golden State at $1 billion , making the Valkyries the first WNBA team to reach that threshold. Meanwhile, during the regular season, Golden State led the WNBA in both average attendance and total attendance.
Playing at the Chase Center — which Valkyries fans have dubbed “Ballhalla” — Golden State has sold out every home game during its two seasons of existence.
body_zh: 2026 年 10 月 31 日晚上 10:25（美国东部时间） / 更新于 2026 年 10 月 31 日晚上 11:05（美国东部时间）
金州武神队仅在他们存在的第二个赛季就获得了 WNBA 冠军。
周六，女武神队在 WNBA 总决赛历史上的首场第七场比赛中以 68-63 击败亚特兰大梦想队，赢得了球队历史上的第一个总冠军。前锋加比·威廉姆斯 (Gabby Williams) 拿下 30 分。
五彩纸屑如雨点般落在球场上，人群爆发出欢呼声，瓦尔基里队庆祝了这场历史性的胜利。
“我喜欢这样的时刻，”威廉姆斯在终场哨响后说道。 “纳特告诉我在上半场要保持耐心。这很难，但我听了她的。她一如既往地正确，她让我们来到了这里，”她指的是主教练娜塔莉·中濑。
威廉姆斯凭借出色的表现被评为总决赛 MVP，她在 WNBA 季后赛历史上半场得分最多。尽管上半场她只得到2分，但她在第三节和第四节分别得到15分和13分。
在接受奖项时，她说：“我不会在万圣节输掉比赛。”
“这真是令人难以置信，”她在第四次获得冠军头衔时说道。 “但我的队友们，他们都很棒。我们感受到的爱是难以置信的。我的意思是，这可能和我的第一个一样好。”
在瓦尔基里队进攻中发挥关键作用的后卫维罗妮卡·伯顿被问到她会对年轻的自己说什么，几年前，她还在家里的基督教青年会锻炼身体，等待参加 WNBA 的机会。
“我会告诉她这一切都是值得的。就像，一切还没有结束。不要让任何人限制你，”她说。 “我们一整年都没有让任何人限制我们。当你工作时，当你埋头苦干时，一切皆有可能。”
金州勇士队迅速崛起，再加上球队狂热的球迷基础，已经使瓦尔基里队成为 WNBA 的标志性球队之一。
在球队的首个赛季，金州勇士队取得了23胜21负的成绩，并在季后赛首轮出局，这是联盟历史上唯一一支扩军球队在第一年就进入季后赛的球队。
在 2026 赛季之前，瓦尔基里队重建了前场，在威廉姆斯首次入选全明星阵容后签下了她，并通过自由球员加盟了前拉斯维加斯王牌队的中锋基亚·斯托克斯。
威廉姆斯成为球队的头号得分手，而斯托克斯则在中场增加了篮板能力。指挥行动的是五年级后卫维罗妮卡·伯顿，她在常规赛期间助攻数领先全队。
重建后的阵容让中濑——两届球员冠军和卫冕年度最佳教练——在总决赛中按下了正确的按钮。金州勇士队赢得第一场比赛后，亚特兰大队以两位数的井喷式胜利卷土重来，以2-1领先。
中濑在第三场比赛后缩短了轮换阵容，同时也更换了首发阵容中的多名球员。随着她更加依赖威廉姆斯、斯托克斯和伯顿三巨头，女武神队以两连胜回应，以 3-2 重新夺回系列赛优势。
亚特兰大队周四在亚特兰大举行的第六场比赛中避免了被淘汰，这场比赛于中午 12:30 开始。东部时间是由于之前在亚特兰大州立农场球馆举行的赛事安排困难，该场馆比梦想队典型的主场球馆大得多，后者的座位数不到 4,000 人。
金州勇士队的夺冠之路恰逢该球队的商业繁荣，该球队与 NBA 的金州勇士队拥有相同的主要所有权集团。
今年 5 月，CNBC 对金州勇士队的估值为 10 亿美元，使 Valkyries 成为第一支达到这一门槛的 WNBA 球队。与此同时，在常规赛期间，金州勇士队的平均上座率和总上座率均领先于 WNBA。
金州勇士队在大通中心球场（被瓦尔基里球迷称为“Ballhalla”）比赛，在其存在的两个赛季中，每场主场比赛的门票都售罄。

title_en: Democrats in key battlegrounds throw Joe Biden under the bus on the border
title_zh: 关键战场上的民主党人将乔·拜登扔在边境巴士下
summary: Democratic candidates in 2026 battleground races are criticizing Joe Biden’s handling of border security, seeking to neutralize a political vulnerability.
summary_zh: 2026 年战场竞选中的民主党候选人批评乔·拜登处理边境安全的方式，试图消除政治弱点
body_en: WASHINGTON — Democratic candidates in 2026 battleground races are directly criticizing Joe Biden’s handling of border security when he was president, seeking to neutralize a political vulnerability and signaling a new path for the party on the thorny issue.
Candidates are throwing the ex-president under the bus on border policy in key states that will decide control of the Senate and some battleground House races across the country.

“I called out Joe Biden for failing us on the border,” Texas’ Democratic Senate nominee James Talarico says in a recent ad airing in the closing stretch of his neck-and-neck race against Republican Ken Paxton. He also criticized Biden in July for having “failed us on our southern border” as he rolled out his own border security plan .
Republicans ‘playing defense’ in reliably red states one week out from Election Day
In Kansas, a longtime Republican stronghold, Democrat Adam Hamilton criticized Biden in a recent debate with Republican Sen. Roger Marshall.

“I want to be crystal clear, first of all: Immigration at the border under Biden was a disaster. That is how we ended up where we are today,” he said. “Second, what we did in response to that has been a disaster for people across the state of Kansas.”

Hamilton, like other Democrats in areas that voted for Trump in 2024, paired their critique of Biden with criticism that the current president has gone too far on enforcement. Polls show many Americans have soured on Trump’s handling of the issue in the wake of immigration officers fatally shooting two Americans in Minnesota and one in Maine this year.

Still, the comments reflect a recognition that the issue of border security remains a vulnerability for Democrats as Republicans continue to accuse them of promoting “open borders” in a bid to mobilize their base and win swing voters. Biden’s ratings on the issue tanked amid a surge in migrant crossings during his presidency, which Trump successfully weaponized in 2024.

Entering office in 2021, Biden inherited a Covid-era migration surge that intensified in the United States after he made good on his pledge to roll back Trump-era policies and restrictions, allowing more asylum-seekers to stay in the country as their cases were being considered. The collective result was a huge spike in border crossings that became associated with the Biden presidency and brought down his approval ratings.

Even as Trump’s approval rating has fallen to 38% , polls show border security continues to be one of his highest-polling issues, although that number has fallen from the highs of his early second term.
“The Biden administration failed at the border,” Democratic House candidate Paige Cognetti said at a debate Thursday night.

Cognetti, who is vying to unseat Rep. Rob Bresnahan, R-Pa., in a highly competitive Scranton-area working-class district, later added: “The Biden administration did fail. We need to make sure that the border is secure. It’s a good thing that it is. We do need to make sure that the pathways to citizenship are there.”
In South Carolina, Democratic Senate candidate Annie Andrews said in a debate, “Democrats have failed on the border.”
Democratic pollster Celinda Lake said it’s “very smart” for candidates to distance themselves from Biden and that “there’s nobody contesting that interpretation” that he blundered on the border.

In the 2024 election, “immigration was playing a major, major role, and it was energizing Republicans. And it was the best issue among swing voters for Republicans,” she said. “ICE has gone too far, and that has backfired now.”
She added that the “best messaging” on immigration is “some control for the border plus a humanitarian process for immigration.”
Iowa’s Democratic Senate candidate Josh Turek traveled more than 800 miles to Laredo, Texas, to film an ad at the border touting his support for tougher enforcement.

“I came to the border to meet firsthand with the people who work to keep it secure. What happens down here affects us up in Iowa, so we’ve got to address it,” Turek says in the ad . “I voted with Republicans to allow law enforcement to arrest and deport criminals.”
Weeks earlier, he released another ad speaking to Iowans and vowing that he would “work with anyone” to fix immigration — “including President Trump, to secure the border.”
Closer to the border, Democrat Johnny Garcia is trying to win Texas’ redrawn and Republican-friendly 35th Congressional District against GOP nominee Carlos De La Cruz.
body_zh: 华盛顿——2026年战场竞选中的民主党候选人直接批评乔·拜登在担任总统期间对边境安全的处理方式，试图消除政治脆弱性，并为该党在这一棘手问题上开辟一条新道路。
候选人在关键州的边境政策问题上将前总统抛在了一边，这些州将决定参议院的控制权和全国一些众议院竞选的战场。
得克萨斯州民主党参议员候选人詹姆斯·塔拉里科（James Talarico）在最近与共和党人肯·帕克斯顿（Ken Paxton）势均力敌的竞选最后阶段播出的一则广告中表示：“我指责乔·拜登在边境问题上让我们失望了。”他还在七月份批评拜登在推出自己的边境安全计划时“在我们的南部边境让我们失望”。
选举日一周后，共和党人在可靠的红色州“防守”
在共和党的长期大本营堪萨斯州，民主党人亚当·汉密尔顿在最近与共和党参议员罗杰·马歇尔的辩论中批评了拜登。
“首先，我想说得非常清楚：拜登领导下的边境移民是一场灾难。这就是我们如何走到今天的地步，”他说。 “其次，我们的应对措施对堪萨斯州人民来说是一场灾难。”
汉密尔顿与 2024 年投票支持特朗普的地区的其他民主党人一样，将对拜登的批评与对现任总统在执法方面走得太远的批评结合在一起。民意调查显示，今年移民官员在明尼苏达州和缅因州枪杀两名美国人后，许多美国人对特朗普处理这一问题的方式感到不满。
尽管如此，这些评论反映出人们认识到，边境安全问题仍然是民主党的一个弱点，因为共和党人继续指责他们推动“开放边界”，以动员他们的基础并赢得摇摆选民。拜登在总统任期内因移民过境激增而在这一问题上的支持率下降，而特朗普在 2024 年成功地将移民过境武器化。
拜登于 2021 年上任，接手了新冠病毒时代的移民激增，在他兑现了取消特朗普时代政策和限制的承诺，允许更多寻求庇护者在案件审理期间留在美国后，移民激增在美国加剧。集体结果是与拜登总统任期相关的过境人数大幅增加，并降低了他的支持率。
尽管特朗普的支持率已降至 38%，但民意调查显示，边境安全仍然是他支持率最高的问题之一，尽管这一数字已较他第二任期初期的高点有所下降。
“拜登政府在边境上失败了，”民主党众议院候选人佩吉·科涅蒂在周四晚上的辩论中表示。
科涅蒂正在竞争激烈的斯克兰顿地区工人阶级选区争夺宾夕法尼亚州众议员罗布·布雷斯纳汉的席位，他后来补充道：“拜登政府确实失败了。我们需要确保边境安全。这是一件好事。我们确实需要确保获得公民身份的途径存在。”
在南卡罗来纳州，民主党参议院候选人安妮·安德鲁斯在一场辩论中表示，“民主党在边境问题上失败了。”
民主党民意调查专家塞琳达·莱克表示，候选人与拜登保持距离是“非常明智的”，而且“没有人质疑他在边境问题上犯下的错误”。
在 2024 年的选举中，“移民发挥着非常重要的作用，它给共和党人注入了活力。对于共和党来说，这是摇摆选民中最好的问题，”她说。 “ICE 做得太过分了，现在已经适得其反。”
她补充说，关于移民的“最好的信息”是“对边境进行一定的控制，加上移民的人道主义程序”。
爱荷华州民主党参议员候选人乔什·图雷克 (Josh Turek) 长途跋涉 800 多英里来到德克萨斯州拉雷多，在边境拍摄一则广告，宣传他支持更严厉的执法。
“我来到边境，与那些致力于确保边境安全的人们进行了直接会面。这里发生的事情影响着我们爱荷华州，所以我们必须解决这个问题，”图雷克在广告中说道。 “我投票支持共和党，允许执法部门逮捕和驱逐罪犯。”
几周前，他发布了另一则针对爱荷华州人的广告，并发誓他将“与任何人合作”来解决移民问题——“包括特朗普总统，以确保边境安全。”
在边境附近，民主党人约翰尼·加西亚 (Johnny Garcia) 正试图击败共和党提名人卡洛斯·德拉克鲁兹 (Carlos De La Cruz)，赢得德克萨斯州重新划定的、对共和党友好的第 35 国会选区。

Judge allows NAACP lawsuit over xAI data center pollution to move forward

A federal judge denied a motion by xAI seeking to dismiss an NAACP lawsuit accusing the SpaceX-owned company of failing to obtain permits needed to operate the gas turbines powering its Colossus data center outside Memphis.

Suing on behalf of the NAACP, the Southern Environmental Law Center said the AI company had “installed and operated at least 35 combustion turbines and other sources of air pollution at the Colossus site without ever obtaining the necessary preconstruction or operating air permits.” It also accused xAI of violating the Clean Air Act.

xAI sought to have the lawsuit dismissed, claiming that the turbines are exempt from permitting requirements because they’re mobile. The company also argued that the plaintiffs did not have the standing to sue.

“Because the plaintiffs have statutory standing under the Clean Air Act, because the combustion turbines are not ‘mobile sources’ under Mississippi’s [State Implementation Plan], and because the citizen suit provision does not violate Article II of the Constitution or the private nondelegation doctrine, the plaintiffs’ claims will proceed,” Judge Debra M. Brown wrote in her decision .

Focusing on xAI’s claim that these kinds of citizen lawsuits are unconstitutional, Judge Brown wrote, “Because citizen suit plaintiffs sue on their own behalf, in their own name, and seek penalties that redress harm to themselves, they are not exercising the federal government’s executive power.”
TechCrunch has reached out to SpaceX for comment.

In a statement , the NAACP’s director of environmental and climate justice Abre’ Connor described this as “another important victory in our effort to hold xAI accountable.” (A similar motion to dismiss from the Department of Justice was denied earlier this month )

“The courts have repeatedly rejected attempts by xAI and the DOJ to dismiss the NAACP’s Clean Air Act case, affirming our right to pursue justice for communities impacted by pollution,” Connor said. “Our position has been clear: xAI cannot operate gas turbines without the required permits.”

The NAACP lawsuit is moving forward as public opinion seems to have turned sharply against data centers, with New York recently passing a moratorium on new data centers and other state and local governments considering similar measures.
The backlash also prompted Amazon and Microsoft to promise to stop using NDAs in their dealings with government agencies, and it could be a significant factor in the imminent U.S. midterm elections .

一位联邦法官驳回了 xAI 寻求驳回 NAACP 诉讼的动议，该诉讼指控这家 SpaceX 旗下公司未能获得运营为孟菲斯郊外 Colossus 数据中心供电的燃气轮机所需的许可证。
南方环境法中心代表全国有色人种协进会提起诉讼，表示这家 AI 公司“在 Colossus 工地安装和运行了至少 35 台燃气轮机和其他空气污染源，但从未获得必要的施工前或运行空气许可证。”它还指责 xAI 违反了《清洁空气法》。
xAI 试图驳回诉讼，声称涡轮机由于是移动式的，因此无需遵守许可要求。该公司还辩称，原告没有资格提起诉讼。
“因为原告根据《清洁空气法》具有法定资格，因为根据密西西比州的[州实施计划]，燃气轮机不是‘移动源’，而且因为公民诉讼条款不违反宪法第二条或私人不授权原则，原告的索赔将继续进行，”法官黛布拉·M·布朗(Debra M. Brown)在裁决中写道。
针对 xAI 声称此类公民诉讼违宪的说法，布朗法官写道，“因为公民诉讼原告以自己的名义，代表自己提起诉讼，并寻求弥补对自己造成的伤害的惩罚，所以他们没有行使联邦政府的行政权力。”
TechCrunch 已联系 SpaceX 请其置评。
在一份声明中，全国有色人种协进会环境和气候司法主任 Abre’ Connor 将此描述为“我们追究 xAI 责任的努力的又一重要胜利”。 （本月早些时候，司法部驳回了类似的动议，但遭到拒绝）
康纳说：“法院一再驳回 xAI 和司法部驳回全国有色人种协进会《清洁空气法案》案件的企图，确认我们为受污染影响的社区伸张正义的权利。” “我们的立场很明确：如果没有所需的许可，xAI 就无法运行燃气轮机。”
随着公众舆论似乎急剧转向反对数据中心，全国有色人种协进会的诉讼正在推进，纽约最近通过了暂停新数据中心的禁令，其他州和地方政府也在考虑采取类似措施。
这种强烈反对还促使亚马逊和微软承诺在与政府机构打交道时停止使用保密协议，这可能成为即将到来的美国中期选举的一个重要因素。

title_en: Mixed economic forecast weighs heavy ahead of midterms
title_zh: 中期选举前经济预测好坏参半
summary: There was a mixed Halloween bag of economic news this week. GDP growth is up, but so are prices. For now at least, interest rates are staying the same. What does that mean for the midterm elections?
summary_zh: 本周万圣节经济新闻好坏参半。 GDP 增长在上升，但物价也在上涨。至少目前，利率保持不变
body_en: Mixed economic forecast weighs heavy ahead of midterms : NPR

Mixed economic forecast weighs heavy ahead of midterms There was a mixed Halloween bag of economic news this week. GDP growth is up, but so are prices. For now at least, interest rates are staying the same. What does that mean for the midterm elections?
Mixed economic forecast weighs heavy ahead of midterms
There was a mixed Halloween bag of economic news this week. GDP growth is up, but so are prices. For now at least, interest rates are staying the same. What does that mean for the midterm elections?

As we just heard, many midterm races are extremely tight. And for voters, the economy has consistently ranked as a top issue driving them to the polls. This week, just days away from Election Day, we got some key economic news. New GDP numbers show the U.S. economy is growing at a healthy clip, but inflation remains stubbornly high. The Federal Reserve met and decided not to raise interest rates, but higher borrowing costs could still be in store by the end of the year. So what does that mean for the midterms? NPR's Scott Horsley is with us to explain.
SCOTT HORSLEY, BYLINE: Hi. Good to be with you.
PFEIFFER: So affordability, that word we hear over and over and over again. It's at the top of mind of so many voters. What is the new economic data tell us about that?

HORSLEY: Well, it tells us affordability is still a challenge. You know, the cost of living keeps going up, and people's paychecks are not keeping pace. This week, the Commerce Department clocked inflation in September at 3.6%. That's higher than the month before. And significantly, it's higher than it was when President Trump returned to the White House. That's a big reason nearly two-thirds of Americans disapprove of the president's economic stewardship. Voters punished Democrats for inflation back in 2024, and they may decide to punish Republicans this time around.
PFEIFFER: Yet we have the seeming contradiction, which is that the latest numbers show the economy is growing. So why isn't that registering or paying off for ordinary voters?

HORSLEY: Yeah. The economy did perk up a bit in late summer and early fall. GDP, which is the broadest measure of economic activity, grew at an annual rate of 3.4% in July, August and September. That's up from 2.2% the previous quarter. Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh said this past week, that's a good sign.
KEVIN WARSH: The economy is strong. The economy is pointing in the right direction.

HORSLEY: But a lot of that GDP growth is being driven by the huge investment in artificial intelligence. And, you know, if you build data centers for a living, you're pretty busy these days. But otherwise, this burst of economic growth has not been accompanied by a burst of new jobs.
PFEIFFER: And, Scott, what about the job market? What about unemployment numbers?

HORSLEY: Yeah, the job market is still really sluggish. Employers added just 29,000 jobs in September. We're going to get the October numbers this coming week. Even though unemployment is low, just 4.2%, most people don't feel confident that if they quit their job, they can find another one. So they're just staying put. And Chief Economist Mark Zandi of Moody's Analytics, says that means there's not much pressure on employers to raise wages.
MARK ZANDI: There's no hiring. Hiring rates are extraordinarily low, and that's just not consistent with a healthy labor market.
HORSLEY: Wages are growing more slowly than they used to. New figures for September show spending rose 2.5 times as fast as wages did. So it's no wonder people feel concerned about affordability.

PFEIFFER: And we know that many people are aggravated about everyday purchases, like gasoline and groceries. But then there are the major purchases, like a house, which is usually what makes people feel economically secure. How is the housing market look in terms of the ability to buy one?

HORSLEY: I'm afraid the housing market is still haunted by high mortgage rates. Even though the Fed did not raise short-term borrowing costs this week, longer term rates are still high. The average cost of a 30 year home loan is around 7.25%. And Zandi says that's keeping a lot of would-be buyers on the sidelines.

ZANDI: I had been hopeful before this run up in rates that mortgage rates would hang around 6%. And if that were the case, then the housing market would start to fall. We get more home sales. But no, we're now well north of 7% on a fixed rate mortgage. Housing is the most interest rate sensitive sector of the economy, and it is taking it on the chin.
body_zh: 中期选举前，经济预测好坏参半：NPR
中期选举前经济预测好坏参半 本周万圣节经济新闻好坏参半。 GDP 增长在上升，但物价也在上涨。至少目前，利率保持不变。这对中期选举意味着什么？
中期选举前经济预测好坏参半
本周万圣节经济新闻好坏参半。 GDP 增长在上升，但物价也在上涨。至少目前，利率保持不变。这对中期选举意味着什么？
正如我们刚刚听说的，许多期中比赛都非常激烈。对于选民来说，经济一直是推动他们投票的首要问题。本周，距离选举日仅几天，我们得到了一些重要的经济新闻。新的GDP数据显示美国经济正在健康增长，但通胀仍然居高不下。美联储召开会议并决定不加息，但到年底借贷成本仍可能上升。那么这对中期选举意味着什么呢？ NPR 的斯科特霍斯利与我们一起解释。
斯科特·霍斯利连线：大家好。很高兴和你在一起。
PFEIFFER：所以负担能力，这个词我们一遍又一遍地听到。这是许多选民最关心的问题。新的经济数据告诉我们什么？
霍斯利：嗯，这告诉我们负担能力仍然是一个挑战。你知道，生活成本不断上涨，而人们的工资却跟不上。本周，商务部公布 9 月份通胀率为 3.6%。这比前一个月还要高。值得注意的是，这一数字比特朗普总统重返白宫时还要高。这是近三分之二的美国人不赞成总统的经济管理的一个重要原因。早在 2024 年，选民就因通货膨胀而惩罚了民主党人，这次他们可能会决定惩罚共和党人。
PFEIFFER：然而，我们有一个看似矛盾的问题，那就是最新数据显示经济正在增长。那么为什么这没有为普通选民登记或带来回报呢？
霍斯利：是的。夏末秋初，经济确实有所复苏。 GDP是​​最广泛的经济活动衡量标准，7月、8月和9月的年增长率为3.4%。这比上一季度的 2.2% 有所上升。美联储主席凯文·沃什上周表示，这是一个好兆头。
凯文·沃什：经济强劲。经济正朝着正确的方向发展。
霍斯利：但是 GDP 增长很大程度上是由人工智能的巨额投资推动的。而且，您知道，如果您以构建数据中心为生，那么这些天您会非常忙碌。但除此之外，这次经济增长并没有伴随着新就业岗位的激增。
PFEIFFER：斯科特，就业市场怎么样？失业数字又如何呢？
霍斯利：是的，就业市场仍然非常低迷。 9月份雇主仅增加了29,000个工作岗位。我们将在下周得到 10 月份的数据。尽管失业率很低，仅为 4.2%，但大多数人对于辞职后能否找到另一份工作并没有信心。所以他们只是原地踏步。穆迪分析公司首席经济学家马克赞迪表示，这意味着雇主没有太大的加薪压力。
马克·赞迪：没有招聘。招聘率极低，这与健康的劳动力市场不符。
霍斯利：工资增长速度比以前慢了。 9月份的新数据显示支出增长速度是工资增长速度的2.5倍。因此，难怪人们担心负担能力。
PFEIFFER：我们知道，许多人对日常购买（例如汽油和杂货）感到恼火。但还有一些重大购买，比如房子，这通常会让人们感到经济上有保障。就购买房屋的能力而言，房地产市场的情况如何？
霍斯利：恐怕房地产市场仍然受到高抵押贷款利率的困扰。尽管美联储本周没有提高短期借贷成本，但长期利率仍然很高。 30年期住房贷款的平均成本约为7.25%。赞迪表示，这让很多潜在买家保持观望。
ZANDI：在利率上涨之前，我一直希望抵押贷款利率能够维持在 6% 左右。如果真是这样，那么房地产市场将开始下跌。我们获得了更多的房屋销售。但事实并非如此，我们现在的固定利率抵押贷款利率已经远高于 7%。房地产是经济中对利率最敏感的部门，它正面临着严峻的考验。
